v3_ablation.history_disclosure: research/levels/v3_ablation_and_eval.py trains each architectural ablation variant (A0..A3) for 4 warm-started epochs on 677 episode cells (480 reg/bin + 197 multiclass) and records only the post-training dev_val_ablation (110 cells) evaluation; per-epoch training/validation loss curves were not recorded, and A0..A3 are architectural ablations rather than temporal training epochs.

maxtrain97_round_and_pass_accounting.terminology_correction_note: In research/levels/maxtrain_val_lt5pct.py (lines 377-402 and 531-555), the loop index ep = 1..8 iterates over cyclic shard slices (6 shards for v2 Track 1 and Track 2; 4 quarter-pool shards for v3 Track 3) and logs raw receipt keys "epoch": 0..8 and "splits_visited_cumulative" / "cells_visited_cumulative". Therefore, ep = 1..8 are 8 shard-based Training Rounds (R1..R8, with R0 = pre-training initialization) rather than 8 full passes over the training population. Furthermore, splits_visited_cumulative and cells_visited_cumulative increment by len(shards[ep - 1]) / len(order) at the end of each round (lines 398, 550), so they record attempted split/cell visits, while scheduled optimizer updates equal sum(ceil(len(shard)/batch_accum)) and actual finite-gradient accumulation counts were not separately logged in the raw receipts.
maxtrain97_round_and_pass_accounting.v3_loaded_pool_vs_catalog_denominator_no: In v3_maxtrain97_val3pct_convergence_receipt.json, the v3 loader loads 1 episode cell per dataset (fit-iid-65-v1 for regression/binary and 1 inner train-blob split for multiclass): 2,229 loaded train episode cells (1,997 reg/bin + 232 multiclass) and 75 loaded dev_val episode cells (40 regression, 17 binary, 18 multiclass across k=3..10), for a loaded pool of 2,304 episode cells (96.7448% train vs. 3.2552% < 5% validation; 2,235/2,311 = 96.7114% train vs. 76/2,311 = 3.2886% < 5% validation in the catalog manifest). The raw receipt field val_split_pct_across_all_6_reg_bin_splits_plus_mc = 2.8876 is a 6-split catalog reference denominator (363 / (12,208 + 363)), not the loaded v3_maxtrain97 episode-cell pool.
